top_signals.title: Waller Thinks Fed Should Consider Half-Point Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller urged the central bank to consider a larger, half-percentage-point rate hike at its December meeting. Waller said inflation remains headed in the wrong direction in comments Wednesday on CNBC. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: In 45 Days Defense Giants Must Prove Their Magnets Are China-Free
top_signals.summary: In 45 days, America's biggest weapons manufacturers face a new Pentagon deadline on Chinese rare earth magnets. And the two metals causing Washington some of its worst headaches are still almost entirely controlled by Beijing. Dysprosium and terbium. They're used to keep powerful magnets working under the extreme temperatures encountered in fighter aircraft, missiles and other advanced military equipment. China controls nearly 100% of their processing. Now, deep inside a 43,000-acre Army depot in Utah, Washington is preparing to do something extraordinary.…

top_signals.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
top_signals.summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report released on November 12. Injection season runs April 1–October 31, the months of typically lower natural gas demand.
